description: The single AI-first front door for Nolane video production. Includes 29 internal skills and an explicit routing map for 37 separately activated specialist plugins.

interface.defaultPrompt: Use Nolane Video Command Center as the front door. First restore repo/project state and use its internal skills. When deeper tool-specific expertise is needed, consult the specialist registry and explicitly hand off to that plugin; do not claim hidden cross-plugin calls. Preserve the parallel asset-library boundary, research provenance, render candidates and verify actual visual/audio output.
interface.longDescription: One private entry point with 29 internal skills plus an indexed handoff map for 37 source-backed specialist plugins across engines, storytelling, data visualization, vector/SVG tooling, media/speech, OCR/audio analysis, editorial, 3D/VFX, post-processing, interactive vector, browser, CI security and QA. Specialist plugins require explicit host activation; no hidden plugin-to-plugin invocation is claimed. Protects the separate resource-library workstream.

name: nolane-video-command-center
